corrections.why: 6.1 m is 20 feet, the side length of the 1959 survey's 20 x 20 foot structure. That is a footprint, not a height, and no source gives a height.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts date an L-4 cabin to 1934. The Forest Lookouts page gives 1933 and a standard R-1 gable roof lookout house. No source reconciles the two, so this research keeps both.

notes_for_editor: Build date and design conflict across three sites: 1934 L-4 cabin on two register sites against a 1933 R-1 gable roof house on the Forest Lookouts page. Not reconciled. The brief's height_m 6.1 is the 20-foot footprint from the 1959 survey description, so removal is proposed. One search for an independent record found nothing. The 1959 description is quoted from the Forest Lookouts page; the NGS datasheet itself was not checked. Idaho Fire Lookouts' Hike-In tag is the only access detail. Today's site condition is not in any source read.
